capabilities: Browse notes by date in month, week, and year calendar views
Extract dates from filenames and frontmatter properties
Open matching notes directly or from date-specific note lists
Filter indexed notes by included or excluded folders and tags
Navigate dates with pickers, direct jumps, and a Today action
disambiguation: Not a daily-note creator; it only browses and opens existing notes by date and never creates, renames, or edits notes.
extras: Early public beta; the README warns users to test it in a separate vault before using it with important data. Release assets are cryptographically attested via GitHub Actions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for finding and opening existing notes by the dates associated with them.

relations.evidence: You can also install a released beta through BRAT by adding this repository URL.

summary: Sidebar calendar that indexes note dates from filenames and frontmatter properties and opens the matching notes.
